name: Deployment Conditions
notes: For Quest, Patron, Rival, and Opportunity missions, roll D100 and consult the appropriate column. This table is ignored during an Invasion battle.

rows.detail: A random crew member must sit out this fight. Reduce enemy numbers by -1 (-2 if they initially outnumber you).
Maximum visibility is 1D6+8". Reroll at the start of each round.
At the end of each round, roll 2D6. If the roll is equal or below the round number, the game ends inconclusively.
Whenever a combatant is Stunned, roll 1D6+Savvy skill (0 for enemies). Failure to roll a 4+ becomes a casualty.
The enemy can't act in the first round.
2 random crew members won't start on the table. At the end of each round, roll 1D6: If the roll is equal or below the round number, they may be placed at any point of your own battlefield edge.
All movement at ground level is -1 Speed.
Your squad all act in the Slow Actions phase in Round 1.
Maximum visibility is 9". Characters that fire can be fired upon at any range, however.
